title: Digging for Debris in the BIGGEST Hole in Minecraft
description:
We're back! Time to get into some more technical project on the Wavetech Server, but first we need to brag about the massive hole we just made. Which happens to be the biggest hole ever made in the game, and it happens to be in the nether. So from this hole we have also gathered the most ancient debris of any server.
